# Travis Zane

> Portfolio of Travis Zane — writer, marketer, and creator. A character-select interface mapping three crafts: writing, marketing, and content/creation work.

The site presents itself as a game-style character selection screen. Each character represents a distinct body of professional work with real projects and outcomes.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Character-select landing page introducing The Writer, The Marketer, and The Creator.
- [About](/about): Personal bio and the story behind the character-select frame.
- [The Writer](/writer): Writing work — essays, long-form, and editorial projects.
- [The Marketer](/marketer): Marketing work — launches, positioning, and campaigns.
- [The Creator](/creator): Creator work — NYC, SF, and CDMX in-person experiences and content.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of all routes.
